title: Connectors (MCP)
intro: Connect Gmail, Google Drive, OneDrive, and Notion as read-only sources for this desk.

boundaries.title: Sandbox & Agent Boundaries
boundaries.intro: The host enforces these rules in code on every MCP call. A prompt cannot widen them.
boundaries.readOnlyBody: External writes, sends, deletes, and harness edits are blocked at the host boundary.
boundaries.sandboxBody: Agents cannot reach or edit anything outside the desk harness.
boundaries.subagentsBody: Each connector's toggle decides whether subagents and team bots under the orchestrator may fetch through it. They can collaborate inside the desk, but they cannot widen its policy.
boundaries.scanBody: Fetched MCP content is scanned for prompt injection, and the run's egress guard treats it as untrusted external content.
boundaries.limits: Host caps: {maxCalls} connector calls per turn, and {subagentMaxCalls} calls per turn for a subagent.
